name: New-listing (genesis-window) liquidity provision and initial price discovery
one_line: Be the first sensible quote in new non-sports markets, where first-minute takers pay 12-16c half-spreads, sized by how much of that cost is adverse selection per category.
maturity: Emerging: rent measured on ~160k fee-free markets; no operator PnL; post-fee not re-measured
requires_ai: optional: LLM prior and rules parsing for unanchored new markets
edge: Empty books at listing; first takers pay the visible spread
capital: <$1k-$10k; per-market exposure small; hand over after 1-3 h
opportunity_size: maker keeps median 1.5-3.5c/share early outside sports; R/E 0.25-0.35 politics/geo, 0.86 economy
expected_results: no public data; guess $10-60/day gross before rewards
competition: thin in first minutes; farmers arrive within the hour
validate: Record first 3 h of new non-sports markets for 14 days; pass realised >=1.5c and R/E >=0.5
top_risk: Informed first takers in politics and geopolitics; rebates compressing the rent
solo_fit_reason: Tiny capital, measured category-level rent, event-driven engineering a solo team can do, stacks with first-quoter reward share; the unknown is how much fees/rebates already compressed it.
speed_class: latency-sensitive: first-minute rent halves within 1-6 minutes
capacity_ceiling: ~$20k-50k: rent is per new market, early takers trade small
changes_made: Verified Tables 2, 6 and 9 and the rebate prediction from the PDF text.
Live 24 Sep: 53 of 72 new non-sports markets under 6 h had reward configs; the newest 1,100 markets were all sports/crypto templates.
open_doubts: Live spread snapshot is quotes, not effective spreads, and tag-sampled.
